scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Temperedness at ramified places for globally generic exceptional groups” (preprints/Temperedness-at-ramified-places-for-globally-generic-exceptional-groups-October-5-2026/ramified-ramanujan.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 014 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 101a2a51cda87af8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let G/F be split connected adjoint absolutely simple of type G2, F4, E6, E7, or E8. If π = N′ v πv is a complex globally generic cuspidal automorphic representation of G(AF ), then πv is tempered for every place v. There is no restriction on the characteristic of F, the ramification depth, or the local representation type.
